component: Mail number-input CSS and stylesheet consumers

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The landing moves common native spinner appearance, icon variables and dimensions from themeableDialog into input-fields. Platform input wrappers import those defaults. Preferences keeps wider spinner buttons and applies one half-height formula to both halves; number fields and vCard special-date controls use full button height. The main window and preferences explicitly load input-fields. This does not establish the complete cascade of every dialog or identical platform rendering. No UI or native spinner test ran.
title: Number-input spinner defaults live in the shared input stylesheet with local size overrides
